policy.canon: Explicit approved correction > owning Systems 01–46 > index > historical Core > prototype constants/examples. Apply the recorded supersessions before translating a source statement to an assertion.

status_definition.unassessed: Requirement implementation has not been individually mapped/tested. Inheritance gives a planning contract, not proof of behavior.
status_definition.planned: Reviewed contract; no complete implementation claimed.
status_definition.partial: Subset evidence exists; full framework remains incomplete.
status_definition.implemented: Every applicable rule has executable assertions and implementation evidence; integration still pending.
status_definition.integrated: Implemented and complete server/Studio/client workflow with cross-system coverage.
status_definition.verified: Integrated and tested at an immutable source commit with recorded acceptance proof; live activation still separate.
status_definition.deferred: Explicit decision defers implementation; remains visible.
status_definition.historical: Reference material rather than an active implementation target.

framework-done: Map every applicable FEATURE / RULE and SCHEMA / DATA statement to concrete executable assertions; record canon/supersession disposition for obsolete rules. OUTLINE/EXAMPLE/METADATA rows are reference material, not independent completion claims.
Prove legal success, invalid input, unauthorized actor, stale revision, retry, concurrent request, disconnect/restart and failure rollback with no duplicate costs/rewards.
Exercise account/character/run/instance/Guild/event/world scope boundaries, Ascension and rollover for every owned field. Explicitly document fields that do not apply.
Validate a tiny fixture and reject a deliberately broken definition in the typed editor; preview, publish and pin it without new gameplay code.
Complete the permitted player workflow with keyboard navigation, visible cost/consequence explanation, resume and safe confirmation. No hidden-state leakage through counts/search/AI.
Record implementation/test paths, concrete assertion names, exact commit and automated command/results. Feature flags, migration/rollback and live-readiness evidence remain separately gated.

decisions.resolution: Use the seven existing scopes. Account-level daily receipts survive Ascension; run build/quests archive; active instances block transition; shared scopes persist. Domain field mappings above are the baseline engineering contract. Add a field-specific exception before implementation; do not invent a generic lifetime.
decisions.blocks: Schema work lacking a field-specific state/reset declaration.

decisions.resolution: Reuse the authenticated Action transaction/receipt pipeline and permitted Query projections. Studio authors typed versioned definitions, never arbitrary player-state writes. Client/AI submit approved intents. Planned Action families in this registry are contracts, not claims that endpoints exist.
decisions.blocks: New mutation routes or arbitrary AI/admin mutation paths outside the authority contract.

decisions.resolution: Keep coefficients, curves, budgets and provisional values in versioned typed rules/content. Pin them in runs/instances; label prototype tuning and test boundaries. Do not hardcode new production numbers or convert example subclass/species catalogs into approved content.
decisions.blocks: A framework that relies on an unexplained hardcoded production constant.
